source.authority: Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Statistics
source.surface: Industrial Production / Sales / Inventory Value Statistics Query

sourceConclusions: A current non-tech aligned panel exists on one official source surface for the same month and industry scope.
The official query supports downloadable XLS/ODS reports, falsifying the assumption that the detailed/current surface is display-only.
A stable documented request/download machine contract for arbitrary query selections is still unverified; browser interaction/export UI is not yet a canonical automated collector.
This pilot does not infer cycle direction because the current query used statistical-value mode only; no YoY outcome was requested.
The exact economic definition of inventory ratio must be preserved from official metadata before deriving a substitute ratio from raw inventory/sales values.
next: Capture the official inventory-ratio definition and report semantics.
Determine whether the supported XLS/ODS export has a stable documented or reproducible request contract without hidden-endpoint reverse engineering.
Prospectively preserve downloaded report hash, query parameters, capturedAt and release-knownAt when a collector is authorized.
